title: Custom error documents
summary: ErrorDocument can point to a local page that explains a status such as not found.
introduction: ErrorDocument can point to a local page that explains a status such as not found. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: ErrorDocument can point to a local page that explains a status such as not found.
The server uses the local 404 page for missing content according to its configuration. The file should contain useful navigation.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a friendly sentence for a missing lesson page.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not make a missing script return the home page with a success status.
For more detail later, use this [Apache HTTP Server further reading](https://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/getting-started.html).

seo.title: Apache HTTP Server: Custom error documents
seo.description: Learn about custom error documents in Apache HTTP Server. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
